purpose: Test whether deterministic argmax deployment was causing Round532’s low score against Max Damage.
method: Same 128 team-pair clusters, two outcome repeats per cluster, fixed team selector, and side swaps for each inference mode. Battle RNG is generated server-side; paired bootstrap resamples team clusters. Absolute intervals bootstrap team-cluster means.
conclusion: Sampling does not improve measured score; the paired interval includes zero and both modes remain far below 50% against Max Damage. Deterministic inference is not a sufficient explanation for the exploit. Neither result changes the policy checkpoint or training mixture.
